commander.name: Aminatou, Veil Piercer
commander.oracle:
At the beginning of your upkeep, surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
Each enchantment card in your hand has miracle. Its miracle cost is equal to its mana cost reduced by {4}. (You may cast a card for its miracle cost when you draw it if it's the first card you drew this turn.)

Creatures.name: Ancient Cellarspawn
Creatures.explanation: A growing horror for an enchantment deck: it gets +1/+1 for each enchantment you control, and with Aminatou's miracle discount you can cast it out of nowhere.

Creatures.name: Archetype of Imagination
Creatures.explanation: Gives your enchantments' creatures flying and takes it away from opponents — the evasion that lets your enchantress payoffs connect.

Creatures.name: Arvinox, the Mind Flail
Creatures.explanation: Exiles the top of opponents' libraries and lets you cast their spells — card advantage tied to the enchantment count via its nightmare scaling.

Creatures.name: Athreos, Shroud-Veiled
Creatures.explanation: A god who puts coin counters on creatures and returns them when they die — recurring your enchantresses and big threats over and over.

Creatures.name: Auramancer
Creatures.explanation: Returns an enchantment from your graveyard to hand — key recursion for the Enchantress plan when your auras or payoffs get destroyed.

Creatures.name: Burnished Hart
Creatures.explanation: Sacrifices to ramp two basics — colorless fixing that gets you to the 5-6 mana the big enchantments need.

Creatures.name: Demon of Fate's Design
Creatures.explanation: A flying demon that exiles cards from graveyards and grows from enchantments — both a beater and a graveyard-hate engine for the miracle plan.

Creatures.name: Doomwake Giant
Creatures.explanation: Constellation: each enchantment you play makes all opponents' creatures -1/-1 — mass removal stapled to your Enchantress engine.

Creatures.name: Dream Eater
Creatures.explanation: Flash flyer that surveils 4 and bounces a nonland permanent on entry — instant-speed disruption that feeds the topdeck plan.

Creatures.name: Fear of Sleep Paralysis
Creatures.explanation: An enchantment creature that gets +1/+1 per enchantment and can tap a defender each turn — enchantress synergy plus combat control.

Creatures.name: Mesa Enchantress
Creatures.explanation: The classic Enchantress: draw a card whenever you cast an enchantment — THE engine card of the plan, with every enchantment cantripping.

Creatures.name: Metamorphosis Fanatic
Creatures.explanation: Sacrifices itself to reanimate an enchantment from your graveyard — recursion for the miracle plan.

Creatures.name: Moon-Blessed Cleric
Creatures.explanation: A cleric that tutors any enchantment from your deck to your hand — the toolbox piece that finds your best enchantress payoff.

Creatures.name: Nightmare Shepherd
Creatures.explanation: When your creatures die, it makes a copy token that exiles itself at end of turn — value from deaths without losing the enchantment synergy.

Creatures.name: Ondu Spiritdancer
Creatures.explanation: Draw a card whenever an Aura enters and creates a copy of it — doubles your auras and your draw, an enchantress all-star.

Creatures.name: Phenomenon Investigators
Creatures.explanation: Whenever you draw a card, investigate — with the enchantress draw engine, you drown in Clue tokens.

Creatures.name: Prognostic Sphinx
Creatures.explanation: Flying, can be made hexproof, and lets you scry 3 when it attacks — evasion + topdeck control that fuels miracle.

Creatures.name: Soaring Lightbringer
Creatures.explanation: A flyer that exiles a graveyard when it enters and returns from the graveyard when a creature dies — recurring graveyard hate.

Creatures.name: Solemn Simulacrum
Creatures.explanation: Ramps a basic, draws a card, and replaces itself when it dies — the standard colorless value creature.

Creatures.name: Starfield Mystic
Creatures.explanation: Enchantments you cast cost {1} less and it has vigilance — mana discount that accelerates the enchantment engine.

Creatures.name: The Master of Keys
Creatures.explanation: The precon's alternate commander: opens Rooms and reanimates enchantments from the graveyard — a second enchantment engine in the 99.

Creatures.name: Verge Rangers
Creatures.explanation: Vigilance plus land ramp when it enters — fixing that helps cast the expensive enchantments on curve.

Instants.name: Arcane Denial
Instants.explanation: Counters a spell and replaces itself — the budget counterspell that doesn't lose you card advantage.

Instants.name: Brainstorm
Instants.explanation: Draws 3 and puts 2 back — the best topdeck-control cantrip: it sets up miracles and keeps your best cards.

Instants.name: Inkshield
Instants.explanation: Fogs all combat damage and makes a flying 2/1 token per damage prevented — the surprise blocker that turns a lost combat into a board.

Instants.name: Otherworldly Gaze
Instants.explanation: Surveils 3 for one mana — cheap topdeck setup that also fills the graveyard for miracle recursion.

Instants.name: Return to Dust
Instants.explanation: Exiles two artifacts/enchantments at instant speed — the catch-all answer for the table's engines.

Instants.name: Swords to Plowshares
Instants.explanation: Exiles any creature for one mana — the format's best removal, here to protect your enchantress board.

Instants.name: Telling Time
Instants.explanation: Looks at the top 3 and picks one for hand or top — topdeck setup that keeps miracles live.

Instants.name: Thirst for Meaning
Instants.explanation: Draws 3, discards an enchantment — the precon's signature draw that fills the graveyard for recursion.

Instants.name: Utter End
Instants.explanation: Exiles any nonland permanent — flexible removal for anything that threatens the plan.

Sorceries.name: Aminatou's Augury
Sorceries.explanation: Exiles the top 8 and casts all nonland cards from among them for free — the ultimate topdeck payoff, casting your whole deck for free.

Sorceries.name: Diabolic Vision
Sorceries.explanation: Surveils 5 then draws — massive topdeck setup that makes the next miracle almost guaranteed.

Sorceries.name: Entreat the Angels
Sorceries.explanation: A miracle sorcery: creates X 4/4 Angel tokens, but its miracle cost makes it 5 cheaper — the perfect Aminatou payoff.

Sorceries.name: Ponder
Sorceries.explanation: Top 3 manipulation + draw — the cantrip that sets up your miracle draws.

Sorceries.name: Portent
Sorceries.explanation: Top 3 manipulation + draw at next upkeep — like Ponder but plays around the miracle timing even better.

Sorceries.name: Read the Bones
Sorceries.explanation: Draws 2, loses 2 life, and scries 2 — solid card advantage with topdeck setup.

Sorceries.name: Redress Fate
Sorceries.explanation: Returns an enchantment from your graveyard and creates a token copy of it — recursion + doubling for the enchantress engine.

Sorceries.name: Terminus
Sorceries.explanation: A miracle board wipe: puts all creatures on the bottom of libraries for just {W} with the miracle discount — the cleanest reset.

Sorceries.name: Time Wipe
Sorceries.explanation: Bounces your own creatures and wipes the rest — asymmetric wipe that keeps your enchantress creatures.

description: **Engine** : play enchantments to draw cards — Mesa Enchantress, Ondu Spiritdancer (doubles auras), Starfield Mystic (discount).
**Miracle synergy** : Aminatou's miracle −{4} makes every enchantment in hand a cheap blowout; surveil 2 each upkeep feeds both the enchantment count and the miracle trigger.
**Snowball** : each enchantment cantrips, the board grows, and control pieces (Doomwake Giant constellation) keep the table in check.
win: **Angel army** : Sigil of the Empty Throne turns every enchantment into a 4/4 Angel.
**Copy engine** : Extravagant Replication doubles your best permanent each upkeep.
**Top-of-library** : One with the Multiverse plays from the top of your library.
**Finisher** : Redress Fate recursion or a giant Entreat the Angels (miracle for {W}{W}{W}{W}).

description: **Setup** : surveil 2 at upkeep + cantrips (Brainstorm, Ponder, Portent, Telling Time), Halimar Depths and Brainstone stack the top of the library.
**Payoff** : miracle draws always hit — Aminatou's discount turns any enchantment into a cheap answer.
**Engine** : One with the Multiverse turns the top of the library into an extra hand.
win: **Free spells** : Aminatou's Augury casts your whole top 8 for free.
**Cheap wipe** : Terminus becomes a one-mana wipe via miracle.
**Beatdown** : Entreat the Angels and Shark Typhoon finish from the top.
**Infinite turns** : Timestream Navigator + Extravagant Replication (see combos).

combos.title: Timestream Navigator + Extravagant Replication
combos.description:
During your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
During your next upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the ability of a Timestream Navigator token that did not enter the battlefield this turn by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn.
Repeat from 2.

combos.title: Wanderwine Prophets + Extravagant Replication
combos.description:
Declare Wanderwine Prophets as an attacker.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Wanderwine Prophets.
Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Merfolk token and take an extra turn after this one.
At the begining of your upkeep Extravagant Replication triggers creating a copy of a merfolk you control.
Repeat each turn.
combos.notablePrerequisites: Wanderwine Prophets cannot be blocked by opponents.
combos.easyPrerequisites:
Wanderwine Prophets does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one other merfolk.

combos.title: Second Chance + Extravagant Replication
combos.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance and Extravagant Replication trigger.
Resolve the Extravagant Replication trigger, creating a token copy of Second Chance.
Resolve the Second Chance trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

description: **Answers** : Swords to Plowshares, Path to Exile, Utter End, Cast Out, Return to Dust, Arcane Denial + counterspells.
**Refill** : the enchantress engine draws cards back between answers.

text: **Enchantress (2,872 decks) et Topdeck (2,108) sont co-favoris** : 10 des cartes du deck sont dans le pool High Synergy EDHREC des deux plans — les deux archétypes dominants.

**Le deck est construit autour de la capacité miracle d'Aminatou** : 15 enchantements + 8 payoffs enchantress (Mesa Enchantress, Ondu Spiritdancer, Sigil of the Empty Throne, One with the Multiverse, Sphere of Safety).
**Control (282) et Pillow Fort (154) sont soutenus par les mêmes cartes** : Sphere of Safety, Shark Typhoon, la suite de removal.
**Tokens/Combo sont accessoires** : Sigil of the Empty Throne et Extravagant Replication font des jetons, mais la liste n'a pas d'autres payoffs jetons.
**Conclusion** : une classique Enchantress/Miracles control — Enchantress et Topdeck co-favoris, avec Pillow Fort comme plan secondaire naturel.

summary: **Base saine** : 36 terrains, 10 ramp (rocs CMC ≤ 2), 12 interactions, 2 wipes — dans les fourchettes idéales.
**CMC moyen 4.03** : ⚠️ au-dessus de la règle d'or ≤ 3.2 — le haut de courbe est chargé en enchantements 5-8 manas (One with the Multiverse, Extravagant Replication, Aminatou's Augury).
**Synergies/wincons à 25/30-35** : plusieurs créatures 5-6 manas sont des engines de valeur plutôt que des finisseurs.
**Piste d'upgrade** : couper les engines 5-6 manas les plus faibles pour 2-3 rocs/cantrips à 2-3 manas et 2-3 finisseurs dédiés — ramener la courbe sous 3.5 en gardant le cœur enchantress.
